title: The Vesence Platform
summary: Vesence works in Word, Outlook, and as a Web app. Intelligence like you have never experienced before in Microsoft Office.
body_markdown:
### Vesence


Create, organize, edit, and review many files at once. A web app built to handle your entire matter from one place.


[Learn More](https://www.vesence.com/platform/web)


### Vesence in Word


Draft, review, and check documents directly in Microsoft Word. Purpose-built to your firm's styles and formatting.


[Learn More](https://www.vesence.com/platform/word)


### Vesence in Outlook


Set your style, and gather context from your inbox. Draft, review, and check every email before it leaves the firm with Vesence.


[Learn More](https://www.vesence.com/platform/outlook)


### Vesence in Excel


Review, check, format, and create spreadsheets with purpose-built AI. Understand complex data and cross-check against source documents.


[Learn More](https://www.vesence.com/platform/excel)


### Vesence in PowerPoint


Review, check, and refine presentations with purpose-built AI. Catch inconsistencies and polish every slide before it leaves the firm.


[Learn More](https://www.vesence.com/platform/powerpoint)
